final: WITH account_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_amount FROM account_avg) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.avg_amount FROM account_avg AS a CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE o.avg_amount IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_amount > o.avg_amount ORDER BY a.avg_amount - o.avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10
